description: The first example started crooked on purpose, to check alignment (apps.alignment): our anchor 50 m to the side of the line the enemy looks along and our front turned 25 degrees; the enemy faces straight south (180). Placed where both sides see each other (terrain at least 2 m below the line of sight, 3 m grid): between the anchors of first_attack a ridge hides the enemy from the crooked start.
